_note: English UI strings. All safety strings use deterministic templates — no free-form AI.
tagline: A safety net between the hospital door and the kitchen table.
disclaimer: Not medical advice. This is an unvalidated demo dataset. Confirm all results with your pharmacist or doctor.

welcome.title: Welcome to MedBridge
welcome.subtitle: MedBridge helps you understand your discharge medicines.
welcome.disclaimer_body: MedBridge does not diagnose, prescribe, or change treatment. It is a support tool only. Always confirm your medicines with your pharmacist or doctor.
welcome.consent_label: I understand this is a support tool, not medical advice.

medicines.title: Your medicines today
